text:
Ibrahim Khan: Hey everyone — first day here! Ibi (he/him). Joining eng-runtime as an inference infra engineer. Quick setup Qs: did IT already ship my laptop? Also who do I ping for VPN + VPC creds? I’ll drop two fun facts at the end so y’all can roast me.

Carla Mendes: welcome Ibi!! laptop shipped yesterday, should be on its way. DM me your preferred shipping address and I'll follow up. :tada:

Samir Patel: welcome!! For VPN creds ping Marta or open an ops ticket. I’ll add you to the infra Slack channel in a sec. Heads up: infra sync Tuesdays 10am PT.

Marta Gomez: Hi Ibi — welcome!! I own VPN/VPC access. I’ll kick off a ticket and add you to the right groups. What’s your GitHub handle?

Ibrahim Khan: thanks! github.com/ibikhan — appreciate it. Two truths and a lie: 1) climbed Kilimanjaro 2) used to play pro chess 3) hate coffee. Guess which is the lie? :thinking_face:

Carla Mendes: lol hate coffee is def the lie :coffee:

Samir Patel: pro chess seems unlikely — but I guess Kilimanjaro is real? :mountain:

devops-bot: Automated: added ibikhan to #infra-team and created a repo invite (infra/serving-runtime).

Ibrahim Khan: nailed it, Samir — pro chess is the lie. I do love coffee (black) and did climb Kilimanjaro a few years ago. Thanks for the rapid responses! Any docs I should prioritize to ramp on the serving runtime?

Carla Mendes: Start with /docs/infra/onboarding and the runtime README in the repo (serving-runtime/README.md). Also read the caching and batching overview — it helps understand perf tradeoffs. Ping me if you want a walkthrough.

Samir Patel: invited you to the repo and CI. Check your email for the invite link. If the Okta/SSO flow breaks, tag #eng-oncall or DM me.

Marta Gomez: Ticket IT-7892 created for VPN + VPC access. ETA 24-48h for Okta group add. You should see Okta invites soon.

Carla Mendes: team welcome lunch this Friday at noon — casual. Come join if you can, we’ll introduce you properly. :)

Ibrahim Khan: I’ll be there — thanks everyone for the warm welcome :wave:

Samir Patel: welcome aboard! excited to have you on the infra side.

devops-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist assigned to Ibrahim Khan (due in 7 days).
